findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router status reports log file path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and writes invocation metrics to the configured call log path

findings.expected_benefit: Restores model routing telemetry and auditability for inference calls

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic in research platform runtime

evidence.observation: TODO markers indicate unimplemented Supabase authorization checking, memory integration, and placeholder logic

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 authorization checks and memory integration in research_command.py

findings.expected_benefit: Completes planned authorization and state persistence for research operations

findings.title: Unimplemented anomaly querying in quality forecasting

evidence.observation: Empty list assigned with TODO marker to query quality_anomalies table

proposed_action.description: Implement Supabase or database query to fetch records from quality_anomalies table

findings.expected_benefit: Enables quality anomaly forecasting rather than defaulting to empty results

findings.title: Emergency alert module bypasses model router via direct provider calls

evidence.observation: emergency_alert module invokes call_gemini and call_mistral directly with environment API keys rather than querying router at port 8891

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM queries through the centralized model router using appropriate task types

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures central governance, fallbacks, and observability for emergency alert synthesis
